fixed.title: Inbox thread cannot be opened outside the owner rep
fixed.evidence: src/app/api/leads/[id]/conversation/route.ts called loadConversation(store,id); store.getLead(id) with no scope throws 'You are not the owner of this lead.' unless reps.role='admin'. invitations.ts repRoleFor() maps MANAGER and MEMBER to reps.role='rep', so every manager opening a teammate conversation (desktop auto-select picks one) saw 'Could not load the conversation.'.
fixed.rootCause: Queue authority (operational scope + executable/covered identities) was never threaded into the conversation read/write paths.
fixed.fix: Added LeadReadScope.identityIds; resolveConversationAuthz(); threaded scope through loadConversation/composeForLead/logSentMessage/saveDraft path/markContacted/recordProspectReply.

fixed.title: Intelligence pane used a different, broader scope than the queue
fixed.evidence: chat-intelligence.ts authorized on repInScope(scope, ownerRepId) only. A manager who chose scope=me still received full context for a teammate lead the queue hid; a covering rep got 'Lead context could not be loaded.' for a row the queue surfaced.
fixed.rootCause: loadChatIntelligence received raw ctx.scope and ignored covered/executable profiles and the personal-scope override.
fixed.fix: canOpenConversationLead() + explicit repIds/authorizedIdentityIds from the page's queue computation; getIntelligence is failure-isolated.

fixed.title: Work Setup silently overwrites a concurrent admin edit
fixed.evidence: GET returns row.revision documented as 'POST this back as expectedRevision'; the component contained zero occurrences of revision/expectedRevision, so computeAccountRevision was never called. A 409 response body's `current` row was discarded and only a string shown.
fixed.rootCause: Client/server CAS contract half-wired.
fixed.fix: draftFromRow captures expectedRevision; save() posts it; HTTP 409 renders workSetupConflictLines(current,draft) with 'Load latest and re-edit' / 'Discard my changes'; Save disabled while a conflict is open.

fixed.title: Clearing one lane's allocations is a silent no-op
fixed.evidence: work-setup-write.ts seeded affected lanes from input.allocations only; blanking lane A while lane B kept shares left A's shares active although the drawer showed 0/10 before saving.
fixed.rootCause: Lane set derived from the supplied allocation rows instead of the supplied target lanes.
fixed.fix: Always seed activities from input.targets; keep the active-plan fallback only when no target list is supplied.

fixed.title: 'Remove plan' on an operator row deletes the whole channel plan
fixed.evidence: supabase-store.deactivateDailyPlanAdmin updates every active daily_target_plans row for the revenue_identity and ignores repId apart from audit text; the UI rendered the button for any row with target>0, including operators/backups.
fixed.rootCause: Channel-level operation exposed on seat-level rows.
fixed.fix: Control now renders only on the PRIMARY responsibility row, where 'the channel's plan' is accurate.
fixed.regressionTest: none (UI-gating change; verify in browser when staging is available)

fixed.title: End day always records an incomplete shortfall
fixed.evidence: Both close controls hardcoded { mode: 'incomplete' }; the API accepts 'complete' and only refuses when requiredRemaining>0 without an approved exception.
fixed.rootCause: Client never attempted the completing close.
fixed.fix: Attempt mode:'complete'; on refusal show the API message and offer 'End day anyway' (incomplete).

fixed.title: /admin/people admitted a demoted admin via stale reps.role
fixed.evidence: Page gate was user.rep.role !== 'admin' && !authCtx.isOwner && !isAdmin, contradicting src/lib/auth/admin-page.ts and the canonical organization_roles source.
fixed.rootCause: Non-canonical role check.
fixed.fix: Use requireProductAdmin(); removed the redundant imports.

fixed.title: V4Drawer is not an accessible modal
fixed.route: shared (Work Setup, setup assistant, assignment drawer)
fixed.evidence: v4/primitives.tsx V4Drawer had role=dialog/aria-modal but no Escape handler, no Tab trap, no body scroll lock and no focus restoration.
fixed.rootCause: Missing modal behaviour.
fixed.fix: Escape closes, focus moves into the panel, Tab cycles inside, background scroll locks, focus returns to the trigger.
fixed.regressionTest: none (requires an authenticated surface; fixture surfaces do not use V4Drawer)

fixed.title: Dialog has no focus trap or scroll lock and can exceed the viewport
fixed.evidence: ui/dialog.tsx handled Escape and focus restore only.
fixed.rootCause: Missing modal behaviour.
fixed.fix: Focus trap, body scroll lock, max-h-[90dvh] overflow-y-auto.

fixed.title: Optional relay-queue reads could crash /tasks
fixed.evidence: store.getRelayQueueData() and store.getSuppressedLeadIds() were awaited without .catch, unlike the dashboard's identical reads.
fixed.rootCause: Missing graceful degradation.
fixed.fix: Mirror the dashboard fallbacks.

fixed.title: QuickComplete failed silently
fixed.evidence: try/finally without catch; a 403/409 rejected inside void complete() with no user feedback.
fixed.rootCause: Unhandled rejection.
fixed.fix: Catch and render an inline role=alert error next to the action.

fixed.title: Recent-prospect rows looked clickable but did nothing
fixed.evidence: DataTable marks every row clickable when onRowClick exists; the handler only navigated when row.convertedLeadId was set.
fixed.rootCause: Table-wide interactivity without a per-row predicate.
fixed.fix: Added DataTable isRowClickable; recent tab supplies Boolean(row.convertedLeadId).

fixed.title: POST /api/tasks dropped revenueIdentityId
fixed.evidence: Route destructured assigneeRepId..profileId but not revenueIdentityId, so assigned tasks lost channel attribution even though createAssignedTask accepts it.
fixed.rootCause: Omitted field in the request mapping.
fixed.fix: Forward revenueIdentityId.

fixed.title: Inbox tab counts ignored Age/Stage filters; Won drill-down was always empty
fixed.evidence: counts were computed over `all` before minAgeHours/stageGroup narrowed rows; stage=won links land on view=all which excludes closed rows, so a Won conversation could never match.
fixed.rootCause: Counts and rows derived from different candidate sets; stage applied after the closed-excluding view filter.
fixed.fix: Compute counts from the filtered candidate set; apply the stage to all rows and let it reach closed conversations when the effective view is All.

fixed.title: Manager scope=me was silently dropped from URL state
fixed.evidence: current/linkState omitted scope, so AutoSelectConversation replaced the URL and every tab/filter/conversation link widened back to the team without warning; Clear filters also omitted scope.
fixed.rootCause: URL state incomplete.
fixed.fix: Persist scope=me in current/linkState and in the clear-filters record.

fixed.title: An intelligence read failure took down the whole thread
fixed.evidence: SelectedThread/IntelligenceSlot awaited getIntelligence with no try/catch despite comments promising isolation.
fixed.rootCause: Unguarded await.
fixed.fix: getIntelligence catches loader errors and returns null (the already-handled unavailable path).

fixed.title: Upwork history logging claimed a send and swallowed failures
fixed.reason: Requires a product decision: implement a real Upwork send or relabel to Log reply/Log follow-up. Route comments state the endpoint is history-only.
fixed.rootCause: History-only endpoints were labelled as sending; the UI appended optimistically inside catch{} and ignored non-2xx.
fixed.fix: Check res.ok, surface an inline error, append only after success; relabel to Log reply and stop claiming delivery in the follow-up prompt.

fixed.title: Rep360 mixed personal target with lane/profile totals
fixed.reason: Needs a single chosen basis (personal share vs profile requirement); accounting parity is protected, so no unilateral change.
fixed.rootCause: The header summed lane targets while per-lane remaining used the same number against a profile total, so shared unallocated lanes looked like a personal expectation.
fixed.fix: Compute each lane through lanePersonalTarget using allocations + seats; expose target (personal) and profileTarget (lane) separately; todayRemaining sums personal remaining.

fixed.title: Team profile detail hid people/coverage/knowledge controls from MANAGE_REVENUE_IDENTITIES managers
fixed.reason: Verified gate mismatch; fix is one predicate but touches a protected authorization surface.
fixed.rootCause: Page gate was admin-only while the list page and the APIs accept MANAGE_REVENUE_IDENTITIES; target editing is a different capability again.
fixed.fix: Split canManage (people/coverage/knowledge, capability-aware) from canManageTargets (MANAGE_TEAM_TARGETS).

fixed.title: Setup assistant / Rep360 wrote targets through MANAGE_TEAM_TARGETS without checking results
fixed.reason: Needs capability gating plus response checking across two flows.
fixed.rootCause: Entry gate granted only MANAGE_REVENUE_IDENTITIES; target responses were never inspected.
fixed.fix: Thread canManageTargets into the setup assistant (skip with an explicit log when absent) and check every Rep360 target response.

fixed.title: Performance targets attributed an unallocated shared lane to the primary
fixed.reason: Contradicts canonical lanePersonalTarget; requires the same product decision as SR-U3.
fixed.rootCause: The targets projection fell back to the PRIMARY rep for any lane without allocations.
fixed.fix: Project only seats through lanePersonalTarget; unallocated multi-seat lanes produce no personal row.

unresolved.reason: API supports senderProfileId/revenueIdentityId and Prospect Analyzer sends them; whether manual intake should follow the active workspace is a product decision.

unresolved.reason: Editors drop zeros and the writer rejects non-positive lanes; needs an agreed '0 = remove lane' semantic in the atomic writer.

unresolved.title: Profiles Table density ignores workspace filters
unresolved.reason: Filter state must be lifted into the workspace or passed to the table.

unresolved.reason: No role editor exists; either build one or remove the control.

unresolved.reason: No drilldown exists on that surface; decide between adding one and removing the affordance.

unresolved.reason: Review count is capped at the scanned page; comment references UI copy that does not exist.
